fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Built-in mode understands English, French and Arabic with rules and sends no data outside your server. Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible mode uses an LLM only to plan the query (and optionally to phrase the answer).

fields.label: Let the AI write the final answer
fields.description: If enabled, the (permission-filtered) result rows are sent to the AI provider to phrase the answer. Leave off to keep all data on your server.

fields.label: Queryable DocTypes
fields.description: One DocType per line. The chatbot can never query anything outside this list, and always only what the current user may read. Sensitive system DocTypes (User, Role, Error Log...) are blocked regardless.

fields.label: Max Questions Per User Per Minute
Send Help Questions Immediately
fields.description: If off (default), clicking an example in the Help window only inserts it in the chat box so the user can edit it first.

fields.label: Super Admins See All Data
fields.description: When enabled (default), Administrator and any user with the System Manager role bypass document-level and field-level permission checks for the DocTypes on the allow-list below (the DocType allow-list, blocked DocTypes and read-only nature of the chatbot still always apply).
